extracted.intended_audience: Office of Finance management and staff responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 / Agency finance managers
extracted.subtask_description: Internal agency implementation plan for OMB Circular A-44 focusing on management improvement and cost reduction across finance operations (ADP, accounting procedures, reorganization, training, records, decentralization). Intended as specific operational targets for the Office of Finance.

rubrics_metrics.name: ADP Applications (overall)
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue to participate with the Office of Computer Service representatives to improve and increase ADP applications for the processing of financial data with emphasis on greater efficiency, reduction in manual operations, greater flexibility to meet changing requirements and more timely reporting to various levels of financial management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific targets during the reporting period are listed in subitems a through h (financial reporting, payroll system, savings bonds printing, contract information system, voucher batch control, advance account header cards, employer tax returns).

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Reporting (ADP objectives)
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue the four-part survey of the use and effectiveness of computer produced financial reports; ultimate objectives include improved currency and turnaround time, reduction in manual record keeping, elimination of certain hard copy reports, greater use of 'reporting by exception' techniques, review of other government agencies' systems, and general updating of reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey commenced July 1970; objectives enumerated (1) improved currency and turn-around time, (2) reduction in manual record keeping, (3) elimination of certain hard copy reports, (4) greater use of 'reporting by exception', (5) review systems of other Government agencies, (6) general updating of reporting requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payroll System (computer-based integrated payroll)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide assistance to SIPS group in development of System Design Specifications for a new computer-based integrated payroll system for all personnel under official cover; system to provide for biweekly payrolling of overseas personnel and expected manpower savings in Compensation and Tax Division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Goal is to implement biweekly overseas payrolling and achieve unspecified manpower savings by automating payroll processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. Savings Bonds printing method
rubrics_metrics.description: Devise a proposed method for printing savings bonds which will permit discontinuing use of outdated addressograph plates and related equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective is to modernize bond-printing processes to eliminate obsolete manual equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contract Information System
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a plan to provide for the input of financial data into the procurement subsystem and provide outputs which will (1) eliminate the need for manual recording of approximately 2,100 vendor card files maintained by C&LD, (2) aid ICAD of vendor accounts subject to audit, and (3) eliminate manual preparation of certain reports by ICAD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate financial and procurement data to remove duplicated manual vendor/accounting work and support audit functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voucher Batch Control (computer verification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Utilize existing computer capabilities in the voucher recording process for verification of debit and credit inputs for batch control purposes to eliminate the current requirement for manual verification of voucher totals and preparation of batch totals for approximately 300 vouchers per day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace manual batch total verification with automated computer checks to save labor and reduce manual operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance Account Header Cards (automation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Utilize a computer prepared personnel roster to assign names and division locations to advance accounts; eliminate the present manual operation of preparing header card inputs and verifying advance accounts to determine if a header card has been established.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use payroll/personnel data as a by-product to populate account header information and remove manual header-card preparation and lookups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer Tax Returns (automated reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrange for computer prepared reports to be produced as a by-product of the Agency's payroll system to provide the data needed for preparation of employer tax returns and permit discontinuance of maintenance of double entry accounting records for such payrolling facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage payroll system outputs to generate employer tax return data and eliminate duplicate accounting records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconciliation of Property Accountings (simplification via sampling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Simplify procedures for reconciling Type II installations' annual property accountings with headquarters control accounts by use of selective reviews and sampling techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt selective review and sampling to reduce research, analysis, and follow-up correspondence required under detailed reconciliation procedures and to permit more timely processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property Earmarked for Shipment (procedure revision & automation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revise accounting procedures for control of property earmarked for shipment and in transit; eliminate manual handling and recording by Accounts Division of an estimated 40,000 to 50,000 shipping documents per year and substitute computer generated entries and outputs derived as a by-product of Logistics processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automate shipping/property in-transit accounting by integrating Logistics outputs to remove massive manual document handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Finance Procedural Handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop format for and commence work on a comprehensive procedural handbook for Office of Finance internal operations to update and codify existing instructional material and include additional material as necessary to make instructions responsive to current requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handbook will consolidate materials issued in various forms and add new content to create a single, updated source of internal procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reorganization — consolidation of commercial accounting/audit functions
rubrics_metrics.description: Consolidate commercially oriented accounting and auditing functions by merging the Proprietary Systems and Accounts Division and the Industrial Contract Audit Division into one new division called 'Commercial Audit and Accounts Division'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consolidation intended to provide more efficient utilization of manpower, flexibility to cope with seasonal workload peaks via personnel interchange, broaden employee experience, and reduce travel and other administrative costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training — Industrial Contract Auditors (reassignment program)
rubrics_metrics.description: Continue the reassignment of accountants from other areas of Finance to the industrial contract audit activity for a long range training program to develop a broad base of trained industrial contract auditors who can readily move into other areas of Finance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use internal reassignment as on-the-job training to create flexible, cross-trained audit/accounting staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Co-operative Education Program (cadre development)
rubrics_metrics.description: Intensify efforts in implementation of the Co-operative Education Program established at the beginning of FY 1971; objective is a cadre of professional accountants oriented and trained across the finance field over 3–4 years. Goal: bring 5 more co-op students on duty during the fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long-term cultivation of professional accountants through structured multi-year co-op placements to build staffing depth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of Reports (central distribution point)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a distribution point in Headquarters Building for critical financial reports to reduce transmittal time by approximately 3 work days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centralize report distribution to speed delivery of critical financial information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Records Storage (vaulting and open shelf filing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Vault certain areas in the Certification and Liaison Division and install open shelf filing to eliminate forty-four four-drawer combination lock type safes and the requirement to open and secure them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Move to more efficient records storage methods to remove cumbersome safes and improve access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decentralization (examine for efficiency opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examine and identify areas where expanded decentralization of functions might offer increased efficiency in processing financial transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess functions for potential decentralization that could speed processing or reduce burdens on centralized units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision Digest (policy interpretation digest)
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop format for and begin work on a digest of policy interpretations concerning application of Agency regulations for financial administration; designed for general information and guidance of certifying officers at Headquarters and field installations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce a digest of policy interpretations to aid certifying officers and ensure consistent application of financial regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Reduction Goals (expectations/timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Although certain goals identified in Section I will, when implemented, result in measurable cost reductions, any such reductions prior to 30 June 1971 will be minimal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that management improvements are expected to create cost savings, but measurable reductions may not be realized within the short reporting period.
